title: Rebearth
description: The Minecraft Earth Themed Resource Pack!
body:
## The Minecraft Earth Themed Resource Pack!
[View the pack on my website!](https://ewanhowell.com/resourcepacks/rebearth)




This pack aims to port all of the custom mobs and features that are exclusive to Minecraft Earth to Minecraft Java! Features: Moobloom Wooly Cow Ender Cat Horned Sheep Muddy Pig Cluckshroom Custom Menu Background Custom Splashes Fresh UI Bone Spider Jumbo Rabbit Skeleton Dog Glow Squid Tropical Slime Furnace Golem Melon Golem
